name: BJFOOD
recent: Berjaya Food 在 2026 财年第四季度营收环比增长 9.1%、同比增长 12.2%，但全年仍录得净亏损 6457 万令吉。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日召开第 17 届常年股东大会，议程包括续期关联方交易授权和回购股份授权。此外，公司因认股权证行使而持续发行新股。
notable: 将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日召开第 17 届常年股东大会。
因认股权证行使，分三批发行共约 2344 万股新股。
risks: 2026 财年净亏损 6457 万令吉，净亏损率 49.7%，较上期的 12.0% 扩大。
认股权证持续行使导致股本逐步扩大。
一名主要子公司董事在闭市期前表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度营收为 1.30014 亿令吉，环比增长 9.1%，同比增长 12.2%；净亏损为 6457.2 万令吉，净亏损率 49.7%，而上一期为 12.0%。

recent_en: Berjaya Food's 4Q FY2026 revenue rose 9.1% QoQ and 12.2% YoY, but the full year still recorded a net loss of RM64.57 million. New shares continue to be issued from warrant exercises.
notable_en: 17th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 7 December 2026.
About 23.44 million new shares issued in three tranches from warrant exercises.
risks_en: FY2026 net loss of RM64.57 million, with net margin at -49.7% versus -12.0% previously.
Continued warrant exercises are gradually enlarging the share base.
A director of a major subsidiary indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: 4Q FY2026 revenue was RM130.014 million, up 9.1% QoQ and 12.2% YoY; net loss was RM64.572 million with a net margin of -49.7%, compared with -12.0% in the prior period.
